sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: In today’s tech-driven world, electronic devices are everywhere—from our homes and offices to factories and even in remote villages. But how do we know these devices are safe to use ? That’s where IS 13252 (Part 1) comes in.

IS 13252 (Part 1) is a safety standard set by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). It ensures that information technology devices like computers, projectors, storage drives, and other smart equipment are built safely—so they don’t overheat, catch fire, or pose an electric shock risk.
What is an Automatic Data Processing Machine (ADPM)
Automatic processing machine refers to the usage of automated techniques to process the data. Typically, this uses repetitive activities to process large volumes of similar data.

Why is IS 13252 Certification a must ?
paragraphs: Back in 2013, the BIS made it mandatory for companies to register these devices under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) if they fall under IS 13252 (Part 1). That means before selling these products in the Indian market, manufacturers must ensure their products are tested, certified, and safe for public use.

Whether you’re a consumer buying a smart TV stick or a company investing in mini PCs for your factory, products certified under IS 13252 mean peace of mind.

At ITC (India) Pvt Ltd , we are committed to not just innovation, but safe innovation. All our ADPM products fully comply with IS 13252 (Part 1):2010, ensuring safety, reliability, and long-term value.
